svg.font-family: Nunito, Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Encoder blocks versus decoder blocks
svg.desc: A side-by-side comparison. The encoder block uses self-attention that sees the whole sequence, then a feed-forward network. The decoder block uses masked self-attention that only sees earlier tokens, a cross-attention layer that attends to the encoder's output (dropped in decoder-only models like GPT), and a feed-forward network. An arrow shows the encoder's output feeding the decoder's cross-attention layer.

g.text: GPT-style LLMs keep only the decoder side.
reads the whole input at once
writes one token at a time
